strips.title: Six months of AI Pro: in real life

panels.head: Black Friday
panels.text: Read the AI Pro footnote, not the banner: some offers already closed.

panels.head: Day one
panels.text: Activate the phone, redeem AI Pro in the Google One app, set a reminder.

panels.head: Month five
panels.text: Decide: keep it at $19.99 a month, or drop to a storage-only plan.

panels.head: Month six
panels.text: Cancelled in time? Access runs to the end of the trial, and nothing is billed.
